name: application-conversion-rate-tile
title: Conversion Rate Tile
description: Conversion-rate tile whose headline percentage is computed from a real numerator/denominator pair (never hand-typed), with an optional trend arrow comparing against a previous-period rate.
useWhen: Showing a conversion or completion rate (trial-to-paid, checkout completion, signup conversion) as a headline metric.
You want the rate percentage guaranteed to match its underlying numerator/denominator, not typed separately.
A period-over-period trend in percentage points adds useful context.
avoidWhen: The metric isn't a ratio of two counts — use big-number-delta-tile for a plain value-over-value delta instead.
You need to show the raw numerator/denominator as the primary number, not the rate — use stat-tile instead.
No comparison period exists and none is planned — the trend arrow can simply be omitted by not passing previousRatePct.
responsiveBehavior: The tile is a single block sized to its content; place it in your own grid or flex row to control column count at each breakpoint.
accessibility: The rate percentage is always shown as real text with one decimal place, not implied by a bare number.
Trend direction is conveyed by both an arrow icon and "pp" (percentage point) delta text, not color or rotation alone.
The numerator/denominator context line is real text below the headline rate, not hidden in a tooltip.

variants.title: Conversion rate tile
variants.description: Trial-to-paid conversion tile computed as 428 of 3,200 (13.4%), with a +1.6pp green uptrend, on a light surface.
accessibility: The rate is computed as (numerator / denominator) * 100, so it can never drift out of sync with the displayed counts.

variants.title: Conversion rate tile (Dark)
variants.description: The same trial-to-paid conversion tile, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Rate, trend, and context text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
